metadata.origin: Earth center for external field; Sun center for solar-system barycenter
metadata.frame: Ecliptic of J2000.0 / ICRF, geometric vectors
metadata.source: NASA JPL Horizons, DE441 vector headers; published DE440 GM table
metadata.principal_axis_sign: largest absolute component positive; this is an undirected line

metrics.g_norm: magnitude of summed external acceleration, m/s^2
metrics.tide_span: largest minus smallest eigenvalue of summed tidal tensor, s^-2
metrics.planet_tide_span: same span from planetary-system tensors excluding Sun and Moon, s^-2
metrics.sun_moon_axis_deg: acute undirected angle between geocentric Sun and Moon directions, degrees

model_notes: External point-mass model; Earth self-gravity excluded.
Planetary systems use their system barycenters and system GM; their moons are not added separately.
Sun and Moon are separate; Earth-Moon system target 3 is not included.
Earth-centered inertial reference; a place-oriented chart can be developed from this tensor in a later instrument.
Events are sampled daily; extrema exclude endpoints. Crossings use linear bracket interpolation.

transit_rules.crest: strict interior daily local maximum of total tidal eigenvalue span
transit_rules.ebb: strict interior daily local minimum of total tidal eigenvalue span
transit_rules.timing: daily sampled epochs; no sub-day extrema refinement; sign crossings use linear interpolation
